core_thesis.market_pain: 播客录完只是开始：文字稿、节目笔记、时间戳、标题、Newsletter、社媒帖子和短视频切片，每期人工要花 3-5 小时；独立播客主请不起制作团队，更新频率被后期拖垮。
core_thesis.opportunity_arbitrage: 把录音当原料一次加工出全套分发物料，按音频分钟数计费对齐转写成本，毛利率可守住 80% 以上。录制平台自带的 AI 说明只解决单点，跨平台分发物料包仍有缝隙；复制者应专攻一种节目形态（如访谈类、双人对谈）把模板做深，而不是全功能跟随。

deep_dive.opportunity: Recording is only half the work: transcripts, notes, timestamps, titles, newsletters, posts and clips eat hours per episode. One upload that returns the full distribution pack, priced by audio minutes, keeps margins above 80%. Specialize in one show format instead of matching every feature.
deep_dive.risk_and_pitfalls: Recording platforms now bundle AI notes and clips, and the incumbent has been flat for two years. Differentiate on one format, watch API costs per minute, and price agencies separately from solo hosts.
workflow: Phase 01: Interview 10 hosts of one show format and rank which outputs they would pay for first.
Phase 02: Build the pipeline: upload, transcribe, then generate notes, timestamps, titles and posts from one transcript.
Phase 03: Meter by audio minutes with starter, pro and agency tiers; add short clips only after text outputs are stable.
Phase 04: Launch on Product Hunt and podcast communities with a free 30-minute tier that converts on the second episode.

metrics.est_monthly_profit: $1,000 - $3,000 / mo (copycat steady state, one show format)

en.summary: Upload a podcast episode and get transcripts, show notes, timestamps, titles, newsletter copy, social posts and clips, priced by audio minutes; founders report about 16K EUR/month, flat for two years.
en.title: Podcast AI Repurposing: One Upload, Full Distribution Pack
en.verdict: Real product with real pricing, but growth has stalled against platform-native AI; copycats must specialize in one show format to earn a C-tier slot.

metrics.est_monthly_profit: $1,000 ~ $3,000 / 月（复制者稳态，单一节目形态口径）

pitfalls_to_avoid: 录制平台已内置 AI 节目说明和切片功能，原版收入两年持平就是信号，别做全功能跟随；转写和生成成本按分钟走，定价必须和分钟数绑定并设上限；免费额度只给 30 分钟尝鲜，防被薅成免费转写工具。
summary: 上传一期播客音频，AI 自动产出文字稿、节目笔记、时间戳、标题、Newsletter 文案、社媒帖子和短视频切片，按音频分钟数订阅收费（Starter 8.99 美元起）。创始人自述月入约 1.6 万欧元、两年持平（C 级证据），复制者须专攻一种节目形态，务实目标月入 1000-3000 美元。
summary_en: Upload a podcast episode and get transcripts, show notes, timestamps, titles, posts and clips, priced by audio minutes.
title: Podsqueeze 式播客 AI 再利用：一次上传出全套分发物料
title_en: Podcast AI Repurposing: One Upload, Full Distribution Pack
verdict: 产品与定价真实可查，但平台原生 AI 已挤压空间、原版两年零增长；只够 C 级观察，复制必须专攻单一节目形态。

workflow_steps.deliverable: 单一节目形态的产出优先级清单
workflow_steps.detail: 访谈 10 位同形态播客主（如双人访谈），排出他们最愿意付费的 3 种产出（如带时间戳的笔记、可直接发的 Newsletter、竖屏切片），其余砍掉。
workflow_steps.title: 选形态并排产出优先级

workflow_steps.deliverable: 转写到多产出的流水线 MVP
workflow_steps.detail: 上传音频后先转写，再用同一份文字稿生成笔记、时间戳、标题和社媒帖；切片功能等文字产出稳定后再加。接口成本按分钟记账。
workflow_steps.title: 转写 + 生成流水线

workflow_steps.deliverable: 按分钟计费的订阅闭环
workflow_steps.detail: Starter 约 9 美元 120 分钟、Pro 约 49 美元 320 分钟、机构档 89 美元起；分钟可结转只放 Pro 以上，免费档 30 分钟尝鲜。
workflow_steps.title: 分钟计费与分层订阅

workflow_steps.deliverable: 首批 20 个付费播客主
workflow_steps.detail: Product Hunt 首发 + 播客社群发真实前后对比（人工 3 小时 vs 一键 5 分钟）；用免费档的第二期转化作付费触发点。
workflow_steps.title: 社区冷启与免费转付费
